facts.fact: GIL optional and officially supported in 3.14 (PEP 779)
Single-thread overhead single-digit percent, down from ~40% in 3.13

facts.verdict: confirmed with official figures; measured value shown

facts.fact: 3.15 headline items lazy imports (PEP 810) and abi3t (PEP 803)
3.13: experimental free-threaded build, ~40% overhead, most extensions unsupported
3.14: free-threading supported, ~5-10% overhead, separate build python3.14t, uv python install 3.14t
3.14: subinterpreters in stdlib, InterpreterPoolExecutor, cheaper than processes
3.15: abi3t lets extensions ship one wheel per platform for nogil
facts.where: Reading s6 box and s7 correction
facts.verdict: imprecise: 3.14t still needs its own wheel; 1 of 25 packages ships abi3t

facts.fact: Practical: target 3.12+ syntax, run 3.13/3.14 in production, try 3.14t for CPU-bound threads, check extension compatibility first

facts.verdict: forecast, not a plan (PEP 779 leaves phase III to a future PEP)
